falsifier_requirement.trigger: Heldout accuracy/RT targets leak into learning-curve fitting, fewer than 20 subjects are scored, dataset hashes drift, or carry-forward/mean comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Fit a training-only learning/memory curve with trial order, stimulus condition, subject covariates, and prior visible trials; score heldout subject/trial targets once.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: training-only task-phase mean and carry-forward learning comparator
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: predict heldout PAM accuracy/RT from training phase mean and last visible trial metric only
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Inspect the existing scorer output, repair the OC model/comparator/residual/materiality implementation, and preserve negative results if OC does not beat the comparator.

required_source_block.source_authority: OpenNeuro / OpenfMRI / Center for Reproducible Neuroscience
required_source_block.source_name: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study

residual_requirement.formula: absolute accuracy residual and RT MAE per subject/trial

target_variable.extraction_rule: Paired-associate memory encoding/retrieval events are parsed into subject/trial target metrics; heldout trial and subject targets remain sealed until predictions are materialized.
target_variable.name: heldout_paired_associate_memory_performance
target_variable.unit: accuracy proportion and reaction time milliseconds

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute accuracy residual and RT MAE per subject/trial
uncertainty_requirement.rule: blocked bootstrap by subject with trial-order conformal residual envelope

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
